name: tmc-graduation-bus-system
description: Military Technological College - Graduation Guest Registration & Bus Management System

scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix server run prisma:generate && npm --prefix client install
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.db:setup: cd server && npm run prisma:generate && npm run prisma:push && npm run prisma:seed
scripts.build: npm run build:client && npm run build:server
scripts.start: cd server && npx prisma db push && npx tsx prisma/seed.ts && node dist/index.js

author: Military Technological College Engineering Team
